title: Updating an App Version by Using ForceSync

facts.text: ForceSync is available for side-by-side upgrades through Microsoft Lifecycle Services.
ForceSync applies breaking changes forcefully to the database schema, typically deleting data in objects with new schema.
Test the ForceSync upgrade on both on-premises and online sandbox environments before production use.
Export a BACPAC of the production environment from the Business Central admin center before upgrading with ForceSync.
Upload a new app version using the App Management API.
Create a new deployment in Microsoft Lifecycle Services to use the new app version.
Issue a PATCH request using Windows PowerShell to set the syncMode property to ForceSync on the app version.
Upgrade the environment in LCS from the old version to the new version to apply ForceSync.
